about: (round 35, streamrender) Tricky Markdown for comparing the streaming renderer (md.js Md.live) with a full render: each document is streamed in random pieces and after every piece the live HTML must equal renderMarkdown(text so far). Used by dev/streamrender-test.js (Node) and dev/checks/streamrender.js (the chat page, through its DOM).
